explanation: The destination must be declared before any copy, then strncpy writes at most 7 bytes, and the explicit termination line guarantees dst is NUL-terminated even when src is longer. Reordering the termination before the copy would leave it overwritten; omitting it would leave an unterminated buffer. The three lines form a single safe copy sequence.
prompt: Drag these lines into the order that safely copies src into the 8-byte dst without overflow or an unterminated string.
